name: Morris water maze
description: The animal swims in a round pool of opaque water and learns to find a hidden platform using cues around the room. Measures spatial learning and memory.

parameters.label: Pool diameter
parameters.help: Inside diameter of the pool at the water surface, wall to wall.

parameters.label: Platform diameter
parameters.help: Diameter of the top surface of the escape platform.

parameters.label: Platform position, left-right
parameters.help: How far the platform center is from the pool center, sideways in the camera image. Positive to the right, negative to the left.

parameters.label: Platform position, up-down
parameters.help: How far the platform center is from the pool center, up or down in the camera image. Positive towards the top, negative towards the bottom.

parameters.label: Wall zone width
parameters.help: Width of the ring along the pool wall. Time spent in this ring counts as wall hugging (thigmotaxis).

parameters.label: Time on platform to escape
parameters.help: The animal must stay on the platform at least this long for the trial to count as escaped. Short touches are ignored.

parameters.label: Tracking gap tolerance
parameters.help: If the animal is lost for longer than this, the movement across the gap is not counted. Raise it only for low frame rate videos.

zones.label: Platform
zones.geometry: Closed disk of platform_diameter_cm at the platform center.

zones.label: Target quadrant
zones.geometry: Quadrant containing the platform center; x >= 0 is east and y >= 0 is north.

zones.label: Wall zone
zones.geometry: Ring with distance from the tank center >= tank radius - wall_annulus_width_cm.

events.label: Platform visit
events.definition: Contiguous counted intervals whose earlier sample is in platform.

events.label: Platform entry
events.definition: Later sample time of a counted interval entering platform.

metrics.label: Analyzed duration
metrics.description: Time during which the animal could be tracked.
metrics.definition: Coordinates are centimeters from the tank center, x east and y north; samples outside the tank count as lost. A counted interval is a pair of consecutive tracked samples with 0 < dt <= max_sample_gap_s.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Escape latency
metrics.description: Time to find the platform; shorter latencies across trials mean better learning.
metrics.definition: Start of the first platform dwell: consecutive tracked samples on the platform, joined by gaps no longer than max_sample_gap_s, spanning at least min_platform_dwell_s.
metrics.formula: first dwell start with last - first sample time >= min_platform_dwell_s
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (EVENT_NOT_OBSERVED) when no dwell qualifies, as in probe trials.

metrics.label: Path length
metrics.description: Distance swum before reaching the platform; a shorter path means a more direct search.
metrics.definition: Distance over counted intervals ending at or before the escape, or over the whole trial without an escape.
metrics.formula: sum(hypot(dx, dy) for counted intervals ending <= escape)
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Mean swim speed
metrics.description: Path length divided by swim time; helps rule out motor problems.
metrics.definition: Path length divided by the counted time it covers.
metrics.formula: path_length_cm / counted time up to escape
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when no counted time precedes the escape.

metrics.label: Share of time in target quadrant
metrics.description: More time in the target quadrant during a probe trial means better memory of the platform location.
metrics.definition: Share of analyzed duration whose earlier sample is in the target quadrant.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Share of time near the wall
metrics.description: Time spent swimming along the wall; high values suggest anxiety or a poor search strategy.
metrics.definition: Share of analyzed duration whose earlier sample is in the wall annulus.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Platform crossings
metrics.description: How many times the animal swam over the platform location; more crossings in a probe trial mean better memory.
metrics.definition: Counted intervals entering the platform disk; starting on the platform is not a crossing.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Mean distance to platform
metrics.description: Average distance from the platform location; a smaller value means a more focused search.
metrics.definition: Time-weighted mean distance from the platform center, using the earlier sample of each counted interval.
metrics.formula: sum(distance(earlier sample, platform) x dt) / sum(dt)
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.
